title: Footsteps on the Ceiling
premise: A tenant living on the top floor of an old building realizes the footsteps pacing above his bed are walking upside down on his ceiling.
subgenre: paranormal encounter in an ordinary home

title: The Mysterious Disappearance of Jim Thompson
premise: An American businessman who revitalised the Thai silk industry vanished during a walk in Malaysia's Cameron Highlands in 1967.

title: The Legend of the Manananggal
premise: A mythical creature from Philippine folklore separates its upper torso to hunt at night.

title: Platform Four
premise: A security guard working at a sealed underground terminal is forbidden from looking inside the phantom train that stops every morning at 3:15 AM.
subgenre: 'rules' horror (a list of strange rules at a job or place)

title: The Beast of Gévaudan
premise: A cryptid terrorized south-central France between 1764 and 1767, resulting in dozens of deaths and an unsolved mystery.

title: The German Legend of the Nachzehrer
premise: A dead revenant in German folklore drains the life-force of the living by consuming its own funeral shroud.

title: The Backward Shadow
premise: A solo hiker breaks the trail's only warning by turning around to confront the footsteps pacing him.

title: The Kidnapping of Patty Hearst
premise: An abducted newspaper heiress shocks the nation when she appears on bank surveillance cameras wielding a weapon alongside her captors.
threat: The Symbionese Liberation Army, an armed domestic terrorist group
twist: The kidnapped heiress appeared on bank security footage armed and actively participating in a heist with her captors.

title: The Disappearance of Louis Le Prince
premise: The pioneer of cinematography boarded a train in 1890 and vanished completely with his luggage.

title: The Romanian Legend of the Strigoi
premise: Romanian folklore warns of the Strigoi, restless corpses that rise from the grave to terrorize their own living families.
setting: Carpathian Mountains and rural Romanian villages during foggy nights
threat: The Strigoi, restless dead that leave their graves to prey upon their living descendants
twist: The monster doesn't hunt strangers—it deliberately returns to consume its own family members.

title: The Stranger at the Diner
premise: A stranger at a diner reveals intimate knowledge of a customer's home, leading to a terrifying discovery in the crawlspace.
subgenre: a stranger who knows too much (Let's Not Meet style, no supernatural)
setting: isolated rustic cabin and diner at dawn
threat: an intruder living secretly in the home's crawlspace
twist: the intruder wrote in his notebook that he left the diner before the narrator to wait for her at home

title: Midnight Knock From the Neighbor
premise: A man home alone at night is warned by his terrified neighbor not to let someone in, only to discover his own double walking down the hallway.
setting: An apartment building hallway and living room at 2:17 AM.
threat: An uncanny doppelganger wearing the narrator's clothes is inside the apartment.
twist: The neighbor outside was warning him about the duplicate already inside the apartment while another copy approaches from the hallway.

title: The Heist of the Century
premise: In 1911, the world's most famous painting vanished from the Louvre, sparking a two-year manhunt that implicated famous artists and tycoons before uncovering a daring inside job.
threat: An audacious art thief who slipped past international police for years
twist: The world's biggest art theft was carried out simply by a former museum worker walking out with the masterpiece under his smock

title: The 2025 Louvre Heist
premise: Thieves disguised as construction workers use a furniture lift to steal millions in French crown jewels from the Louvre in under eight minutes.
threat: Disguised thieves armed with power tools raiding royal display cases
twist: The gallery's security camera faced the wrong direction, and the security password was simply Louvre.

title: The Disappearance of D. B. Cooper
premise: A man hijacked a passenger flight in 1971, collected a ransom, and parachuted into the night, never to be seen again.
threat: An unidentified airline hijacker with an alleged bomb
twist: The ransom money was found years later, but the hijacker and the rest of the cash vanished without a trace.
